slug: 2025-10-29 The Gambia strengthens digital trust with personal data protection & privacy bill

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Parliament approved the draft Personal Data Protection and Privacy legislation, the first comprehensive framework for personal data of all Gambians; no promulgation is stated (published 2025-10-29, no other date).
